title: Liminality
survival_class: SURVIVAL CLASS 0 (Resources 5/5 No Drinkable Fluids; Exit 0/5 Guaranteed Exit; Environment 0/5 No Environmental Risks; Entities 0/5 No Hostile Entities)
physical_identity: The Sandrooms: corridors and rooms with floors covered in thick yellow sand, cracked blue, cream and red paint, sunlight-like light beams, toys in the sand, perpetual rain sound.
scale_topology: Complex of corridors and rooms; extent not stated; impenetrable voidstone ceiling.
anomalies: rain sound with no water (phantom sound)
entry is a random diversion that decreases with age
lighting_sound: Sunlight-like beams from arbitrary ceiling/wall spots; dead fixtures; constant soothing rain sound; 15 C dry air.
hazards: dry eyes and lips from dry air over long stays

entrances.method: small chance when going through an entrance
entrances.conditions: probability decreases with age; group average
entrances.quote: there is a small chance of going to the Sandrooms instead
instead of ending up in the museum, we arrived in some sandy corridor
we climbed through a broken window in level 25
instead of ending up in the concrete warehouse

exits.method: door in a sand-free room, or climb through a window
exits.quote: will send the wanderer to the level they would have entered originally

signature_mechanic: Harmless nostalgic sand rooms with persistent footprints, rain sound without water and light shafts; exit through a sand-free door or window to the intended level.
conflicts_notes: A comment calls the destination 'level 40' when entering from Level 25. Exit door text is ambiguous ('room with no sand'). Most of the page is in-universe testimony.

key_quotes.quote: most of the floor covered by a thick layer of yellow sand
the sound of rain can be heard perpetually
Devoid of entities, it is peaceful here.
there is a small chance of going to the Sandrooms instead
